# EpiRank — Epidemic Risk Analysis via Asymmetric Commuting Networks

> EpiRank is a desktop application implementing the EpiRank algorithm for epidemic risk analysis across Taiwan's 353 townships based on asymmetric commuting networks. It computes risk scores using a modified PageRank algorithm on commuting flow data.
